name: timeseries_split
title: Walk-forward demand forecast with TimeSeriesSplit
origin: the TimeSeriesSplit shape REQUIREMENTS R3.7 asks for and the audit found missing

expected.defect: the feature scaler is fitted on the entire series before any fold exists
expected.why: every fold's training half has already seen the mean and variance of its own future

expected.defect: the target is min-max scaled over the entire series, including the horizon being predicted
expected.why: the target range leaks the future's maximum into every training fold

expected.defect: a fresh scaler is fitted on the test fold and used to transform it
expected.why: the model is scored on features standardised by their own statistics, which is not what it was trained on

expected.defect: build_matrix scales the whole series and the result is handed straight to cross_val_score
expected.why: the preprocessing sits outside the cross-validation, so every fold is contaminated

expected.defect: the boosted regressor is constructed without random_state and nothing seeds numpy
expected.why: two runs of the same walk-forward give two different MAEs

forbidden.why: the splitter is TimeSeriesSplit, which is the chronological answer MLV106 asks for; no shuffled split exists in this project
TimeSeriesSplit is deterministic by construction - it has no random_state and asking for one would be wrong advice on a temporal split
there is no DataLoader here, and shuffling a time series would be the defect, not the fix
no torch anywhere in this project
no torch module to switch into eval mode
no device is ever named in this project
